name: Survey tile in Sextans
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Sextans, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 8 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2025-11-28, at wavelengths from 0.98 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
